notes: Printed: '{2}{R}, {T}: This creature fights ANOTHER TARGET CREATURE.' With a single other creature on the battlefield the ability is activatable with that one target: the Taunter (1 power) deals 1 to the Opp Bear, the bear deals 2 to the Taunter (indestructible), and 'Whenever this creature is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to target opponent' sends 2 to the opponent (20 -> 18).
